body.prose:
A name is unique within its store and resolves to an identity, so references never break when a name changes. The store says only what its names are; `entry`, the mount a client boots into, is the first.

*The store as the namespace the author's, 2026-11-02; names held in the index the session's, 2026-11-03.*

This is how it is built, and it is to change: a holon carries its own name, in its version beside its identity, unique among what each whole holding it holds, and an address is a route of names through wholes, as [the relations](ref:01M6M9PESEPYSZBYWQVD709ACJ) tell; the store's names are then its root's, the first whole an address starts from.

*The author's, 2026-11-04; not yet built.*
body.title: Names
